subject: Request for 3-day warmup voucher while supplier audit clears
messages:
From: Donna Park <donna@medisphere.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot at risk — procurement audit delaying PO, can you help?

Hi Vivek,

Quick note from Procurement: our supplier onboarding team flagged a third-party audit on our vendor routing for cloud services and legal put the PO on hold until verification completes. The audit is expected to clear in ~48 hours but that window will interrupt the pilot we’re running with your API (we’re mid-integration).

We’d like to avoid losing momentum — is Redwood able to grant a short, temporary warmup voucher (3 days) so our engineers can keep the sandbox and CI runners warm while procurement finishes the check? We’ll take normal billing as soon as the PO is approved.

Attached is the supplier audit notice they sent (redacted). Happy to provide any additional info. We appreciate a quick yes/no so we can plan the team’s weekend.

Thanks,
Donna Park
Senior Program Manager, Integrations
MediSphere
[attachment: medisphere-supplier-audit-notice.pdf]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Donna Park <donna@medisphere.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot at risk — procurement audit delaying PO, can you help?

Hi Donna — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the audit notice. Looping in Priya (sales operations) and Karthik (account lead) so we can review the ask and move quickly.

Short answer: we can offer a temporary 3-day warmup voucher in cases like this, but we have a couple of operational guardrails (to protect other pilots and preserve fair usage). Can you confirm:
- The PO number or HubSpot deal (if available)
- Expected clearance time from your procurement team
- Whether the pilot uses production keys or a sandbox token (we need to know if data transits off your network)

If everything checks out we’ll provision a 3-day voucher capped at 50k tokens and with the standard EVAL terms (see attached draft). Priya — can you confirm approval from ops for a 3-day voucher tied to DEAL-2043? Karthik — FYI for the customer communications.

— Vivek
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

--- Original attachment referenced: medisphere-supplier-audit-notice.pdf (redacted) ---

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Donna Park <donna@medisphere.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot at risk — procurement audit delaying PO, can you help?

Hi all — I reviewed the audit notice and the account record (DEAL-2043). Ops is okay to approve a temporary 3-day warmup voucher under these conditions:

- Voucher: 72 hours active from time of grant
- Cap: 50,000 tokens total (generation + embeddings)
- Purpose: keep the sandbox and CI runners active; not for unlimited production usage
- Requirement: customer confirms when PO is approved so we can reconcile and either invoice or cancel remaining credits

I’ve attached the voucher terms PDF and created a short DocuSign to capture the customer acknowledgement (simple one-pager). Donna — if you sign, I’ll provision the voucher immediately.

Attachment: 3day-voucher-terms.pdf
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/some-doc-id

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Priya — that sounds good and fair. I just forwarded the procurement note to confirm the timeline — see forwarded message below. We expect clearance within ~48 hours but the team says sometimes it slips to 72. I’ll sign the DocuSign right away.

On Fri, Jul 19, 2028 at 13:58 Procurement Team <procurement@medisphere.com> wrote:

>
> The external-supplier audit is scheduled for this weekend. We estimate clearance by Sunday evening PST (48 hours) but will update if more time is needed.

Appreciate the quick help — Karthik, please keep us posted as you ramp back up; Vivek/Priya, I’ll confirm the sign and the time we go live on the voucher once DocuSign is returned.

Best,

MediSphere
